purpose: A complete, non-extrapolating reconciliation ledger for the 148 frozen VB5/VB6 rows. Every frozen id appears once and only once below. A disposition is evidence accounting, not a claim that arbitrary applications or OCXs are styled.

dispositions.meaning: A real sample and/or the self-owned dual-width runtime fixture establishes the exact runtime-owned HWND, DC, or standard-menu route. The cited S evidence defines the limited variant coverage; owner-draw, private runtime state, and unobserved variants remain outside the claim.

completion_check: 46 + 79 + 23 = 148. The 23 deferred rows are deliberately unsupported and are listed in docs/states/TODO.md. A verifier must compare the set of ids to source_matrix and reject duplicates, omissions, or unknown ids.

local_discovery_after_p3.method: Read-only recursive filename check of O:\winnt\system32, O:\winnt\syswow64, and D:\programs for the 34 frozen extension module names; separate source-file scan for .vbp/.frm/.ctl/.vbg and declaration names.
local_discovery_after_p3.source_candidate_result: All 41 candidates were a third-party registration profile format; none contained a VB project declaration or any frozen extension-control declaration.
local_discovery_after_p3.consequence: This local environment supplies no runnable, version-correct visual OCX wrapper sample. The discovery has no UAC, display, or user-input dependency.

system_volume_followup.method: Read-only system-volume file, PE, signature, type-library, direct x86 COM creation, and OLE misc-status probes. No registration, installation, process injection, user interaction, or external module copy occurred.
system_volume_followup.office_mscomctl: C:\Program Files\Microsoft Office\root\vfs\System\MSCOMCTL.OCX is Microsoft-signed but PE32+ AMD64. Its type library exposes TreeView, ListView, Toolbar, StatusBar, TabStrip, ProgressBar, Slider, and ImageCombo coclasses; an x86 process LoadLibrary attempt fails with ERROR_BAD_EXE_FORMAT (193), so it cannot validate or support x86 VB5/VB6 applications.
system_volume_followup.msscript: C:\Windows\SysWOW64\msscript.ocx is Microsoft-signed x86. MSScriptControl.ScriptControl CoCreateInstance succeeds, but IOleObject::GetMiscStatus returns OLEMISC_INVISIBLEATRUNTIME. It is therefore reclassified as native preservation rather than a visual styling candidate.
system_volume_followup.consequence: This system-volume observation does not substitute generic common-control paths for a version-correct visual component and public host/child-window contract. The later S28 scratch probe is accounted for in the dispositions above.

user_accessible_followup.method: Read-only filename scan of Downloads, Desktop, Documents, OneDrive, ProgramData, and Windows Installer, plus archive-name scan for VB6/Visual Basic/ActiveX/OCX terms.
user_accessible_followup.consequence: No further locally available x86 visual OCX or installer can safely reduce the remaining set. The only next implementation input is an independently licensed, version-correct x86 visual component together with an inert self-owned sample or a documented public host contract; it must be supplied or become available externally.

result: The ledger closes the accounting gap but does not close T17: 44 rows have bounded verified public paths, 51 require native preservation, and 53 still require a safe version-correct public contract or real sample.
